title: 宝塚記念の後に・メジロの強さ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen sets the stage for yet another fierce Mejiro showdown. Mejiro McQueen displays her strength and beats out Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The curtains close on the Takarazuka Kinen with the cheers of the crowd praising the two Mejiro racers for their valiant efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that the Takarazuka Kinen is over, Mejiro McQueen sets the autumn Tenno Sho as her new goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with a dash, she's off to achieve what no one in her family has done before—successive wins in the Tenno Sho spring and autumn races.
